name: Siren
description: A siren sounds higher as it rushes toward you: each crest leaves from a little closer, so they arrive bunched up. This emitter plays 3 Hz, but the crystal only answers to 3.5 Hz. Send the emitter toward it at just the right speed.
hint: Coming toward you at speed v, a 3 Hz note arrives at 3·60/(60 − v) Hz. Waves here travel 60 cells a second.
